_about: Every raw download The Finder uses. Fetched by tools/fetch-sources.mjs into sources/<id>/ (gitignored), verified by size and checksum. sha256 and bytes are recorded on first download; md5 is the publisher's where one exists. Only sources named in docs/research/ belong here (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
